title: Input Trace
description: A recorded sequence of player inputs for one Attempt, in 60 Hz frames, that can be replayed deterministically. See calibration/PROTOCOL.md.

id.description: Unique id: '<event>/<slug>'. Matches the file path under calibration/traces/ without '.json'.

cycle.description: 1-based Cycle the Attempt was played in.

frames.description: Length of the trace in frames. Frame 0 is the first frame the Event accepts input (see PROTOCOL.md, 'Frame zero').

source.description: 'original': captured from the original by following PROTOCOL.md. 'synthetic': hand-written for tests or examples, never a parity target.

expectedToFail.description: Set when the original's model differs from the sim's and the rework isn't done yet: why it fails and the issue tracking the rework, e.g. '#80: the Rival reacts to the player'. A normal run skips the trace; a strict run fails while any trace has this.

attempt.description: 1-based Attempt number within the Event, for field Events.

barHeight.description: High Jump only: bar height for this Attempt, in the original's pixels.

inputs.description: Presses and releases in the order they happened. Frames never decrease.
